children: Hungary's budget posted a deficit of 2.311 trillion forints ($7.35 billion) in August, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday, due largely to the pre-financing of European Union-backed projects.

The ministry said reimbursement of these expenses would boost December revenue figures. Adjusted for the impact of these items, the August shortfall came to just 124.3 billion forints, the ministry said.
